rationale: Reactive current calculated as k*(deadband-voltage) for V<0.9 pu, clipped to current limit 1.2 pu. Active current limited by remaining capability sqrt(1.2^2 - iq^2) and capped at prefault 0.92 pu. All voltages remain above FRT floor 0.45 pu, reactive current requirements met, duration below floor is 0s (<0.2s limit).
